meta.description: Main planner hardware config for 4 chiplets x 8 SA/chiplet x 4 CU/SA. Total compute CUs remains 128, matching the previous 8x4x4 setup.
meta.banks_note: banks_per_chiplet is set to 8 so total memory banks remain 32, matching the previous 8 chiplets x 4 banks/chiplet setup. Use 4 only if you intentionally want total banks to drop to 16.
meta.chiplet_cap_pages_note: chiplet_cap_pages is doubled from 400 to 800 because chiplet count is reduced from 8 to 4; this keeps the planner's total normal placement capacity approximately unchanged.
meta.chiplet_overflow_note: Soft overflow pages are doubled from 1024 to 2048 per chiplet for the same reason: preserving approximate total soft overflow capacity after reducing chiplet count.
